title: Tools
subtitle: Developer tooling that ships with Pool Party. Read-only, and it never touches your wallet.

hookRisk.heading: Uniswap v4 hook risk
hookRisk.intro: Paste a deployed hook address. hookrisk reads its verified source, compiles it, scores it against the Uniswap Foundation's Hooks Security Framework and returns the report below.
hookRisk.notice: A scan compiles the contract and runs a fuzzed differential harness, so expect minutes rather than seconds. The report is cached for 24 hours.
hookRisk.idleBody: Choose a chain, paste a deployed hook address and press Analyze.
hookRisk.cached: Served from a scan run within the last 24 hours.
hookRisk.gateFailed: hookrisk gate failed. The report below says why, and a failed gate is a result, not an error.

status.fetchingSource: Reading the verified source from the block explorer
status.scanning: Running the detectors and the differential harness

errors.INVALID_ADDRESS: That is not a valid contract address. It should be 42 characters starting with 0x.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN: That chain is not one of the chains this tool reads.
errors.JOB_UNKNOWN: This scan is no longer tracked by the server. Run it again.
errors.NETWORK: The server could not be reached. Check that it is running and try again.
